## Default Permission

Everything the Pikara splash and main windows need: read status, report first paint / main ready, reveal, close, wait for the backend and choose a recovery action.

#### This default permission set includes the following:

- `allow-status`
- `allow-shown`
- `allow-reveal-main`
- `allow-close`
- `allow-main-ready`
- `allow-wait-ready`
- `allow-action`
